description: Saturation discovery run (§8.3): step-ramps from 50 to 1,600 TPS using a 2x multiplier with short tiers to locate the stability ceiling. Mixed payload (70% one-to-one, 30% multi-output). Run only after formal benchmark tiers have been completed and reviewed.
walletProvisioningNote: external-key mode — set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY to a pre-funded key whose UTxOs are initialized on the node before running replay scenarios
